title: Read error messages from bottom up
description: Read JavaScript stack traces and chained causes, identify the first actionable application frame, and explain the root failure without leaking secrets.
objectives: Distinguish an error message, stack frame and nested cause
Locate an actionable stack frame instead of blaming every caller
Walk a bounded Error.cause chain safely, including circular references
Turn an observed stack trace into a focused debugging hypothesis
rubric: I found the originating cause and distinguished it from its wrapper.
I identified the first relevant application frame and reproduced the error.
I passed the bounded and cyclic error-chain regression tests.
